The new study was launched once by adding `p8-cold-run` to this exact head. Its original [run 37954851017](https://github.com/jyqj/codecortex/actions/runs/37954851017), attempt 1, is bound to `044c008c9459cfa61e7701db2eb868342c508a39`. Ordinary CI runs alongside it; Rust and native measurement success are still pending.

The [actual v15 and task-plan execution records](https://github.com/jyqj/codecortex/tree/c24a4a55e89c25a0f25c50879e0e6d7b2e34975d/artifacts/checkpoints/p8-cold-only-actual-admission-a217-20261009) are now committed. Original ledger remains **163 done / 29 remaining / 0 newly completed**.

## Purpose and behavior

Add an explicitly selected cold-only study for the original P8-005 scale acceptance. It measures 1k, 5k, 10k, 50k and 100k files with the fixed seed and release binary, retaining actual chunk/edge/vector status and every sample. The original full-stage study remains a separately identified protocol.

Each of 150 unique scale/repetition slots runs the existing two independent fresh projects, completes both cold builds, compares all 15 canonical tables, and retains physical counts, configuration facts and process resource observations. Five repetition-zero slices run first; all five must succeed before the remaining 145 slices run. The registered N30, 200/1024 work settings, 18,000,000 ms native deadline, 512 MiB output limit, 350-minute job timeout and measurement concurrency 10 are retained.

The new optional `cold_only_v1` scope and run/attempt identity are absent from the default native plan. The original full-stage validator continues to require its full stage population. A separate driver and `p8-cold-*` artifact namespace bind the complete source, binary, driver, study and original raw records. A successful cold prefix followed by a timeout is a failure. Resource observations remain snapshots; the OS page cache is retained.

The new environment record observes the actual seed-cache input and effective production capacity without changing it. Independent review caught an initial parent/worker TMP mismatch; the final version records both directories and verifies their actual relationship to the capacity preflight.
